title: Support Knowledge Assistant
prompt: Answer the synthetic customer’s policy question using the full Gmail message and the actual Notion policy page content. Quote the applicable rule and state any missing information needed to decide the case.
instructions: Search Gmail for the sample question, then get_message for every returned message before interpreting it. Search Notion by policy-page title and call getPageOrBlockChildren with the returned parentId, markdown true, and dynamic {} to read actual content. Do not reply to email or modify either app. If the policy page does not resolve an edge case, state that and do not invent a decision.
fixture_summary: Synthetic Gmail search returns one customer question about a damaged item. Notion title search finds a refund policy page; full block content specifies a 30-day reporting window and required order details.
